title: EU receives €1.4 billion in revenue from immobilised Russian assets to be used for supporting Ukraine
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Aug 2026 On 3rd of August, the European Union received €1.4 billion in windfall profits generated by the interest on the cash balances originating from immobilised assets of the Central Bank of Russia (CBR) held by Central Securities Depositories (CSDs).
